source: Lantmäteriet orto-n2-2026 at 0.16 m (Min karta proxy, the same flight as the retained review windows) + the 1 m laser terrain (trace-tees.mjs deck candidates) + the club's Caddee hole plans (yellow and red tee discs; blue and orange are never drawn)
method: Every hole carried its four card tees on ONE point. A derived platform never stands in water: a station inside a water ring walks forward along the route to the first dry station 6 m clear of the water. A laser deck is drawn as the rectangle of its own principal axes, since a built deck is one and the 1 m flat cells give it a ragged outline. A colour stands on the OBSERVED platform where one exists (22 pads from the 2026 review), on a laser-flat mown deck where the terrain and the imagery show one at the card's own distance (holes 1 and 15), and otherwise at a CARD-DERIVED position: the card's metres to the green centre walked back along the route, moved sideways onto the middle of the mown corridor at that station, with a 14 x 7 m platform drawn there and flagged as derived. Where two colours share a platform (Gul=Blå, Röd=Orange on the card) they share the mark; where a long observed deck carries two card lengths (5, 9) the shorter stands at its front.
